children: Expanded Partnership Strengthens Language Access and Provides Greater Visibility Across Evolent's Payer Network
Enterprise-wide telephonic interpretation expands language access for members with limited English proficiency.
Centralized reporting improves oversight of language services and supports compliance efforts.
AI-enabled technology and professional interpreters deliver fast, reliable service.

, the world's leading provider of language and AI solutions for global business, today announced it was selected by Evolent Health, Inc. to provide enterprise-wide telephonic interpretation services, expanding language access for health plan members with limited English proficiency (LEP) across Evolent's payer network.

This expanded partnership between the two organizations also gives Evolent visibility into utilization trends through centralized reporting and performance insights, supporting NCQA accreditation, regulatory compliance, Medicare and Medicaid requirements, and broader health equity initiatives. Powered by TransPerfect's hybrid model, the solution combines AI-enabled technology with professional interpreters to deliver efficient, high-quality support and the flexibility to meet a wide range of member needs.

"TransPerfect has supported Evolent's translation and interpretation needs, and we continue to receive positive feedback regarding the quality of services provided to the members we support," said Kristen Berquist, Evolent Senior Vice President of Corporate Operations. "Expanding this relationship will help us provide more consistent language access across our organization while giving our teams greater insight into how these services are being used."

commented, "We value the trust Evolent has placed in TransPerfect and are pleased to expand our relationship. We look forward to supporting Evolent as it strengthens language access and continues serving the needs of its diverse member population."

TransPerfect is the world's largest provider of language and AI solutions for global business. More than 6,000 global organizations employ TransPerfect's GlobalLink® technology to simplify the management of multilingual content. With an unparalleled commitment to quality and client service, TransPerfect is fully ISO 9001 and ISO 17100 certified. TransPerfect has global headquarters in New York, with regional headquarters in London and Hong Kong. For more information, please visit our website at www.transperfect.com.
